# North weekly 2025-09-15

Written 15 Sep 2025

## Brackenwater Freight Co. — handoff today

- Brackenwater Freight Co. moves to Marcus Lindqvist today, 15 Sep 2025. Handoff notes, open support threads and the next yard check-in are in the North folder.
- Marcus's freight account has one operational loose end: the afternoon dispatcher is still writing trailer numbers in the appointment notes instead of the trailer field.
- Marcus will walk through that with the dispatch desk before the next afternoon shift. Use the two appointments from door 6 as examples; both were searchable by carrier but not by trailer.
- I have sent the current contact list and the last call notes. The shared mailbox thread includes the screenshot showing where the field sits in Pemberline Dock.
- Keep the handoff practical. The dispatch desk needs a clear next contact and an answer on trailer search, not another introductory presentation.

## Quarrendon Freight Lines — amendment live

- The 185-seat amendment has been live since 1 Sep 2025. Dana Okafor is checking the remaining user invitations against Thea Ramaswell’s shift roster.
- Dana's freight account needs the night-shift supervisors included in the roster check, not just the daytime office users.
- Thea flagged two invitations sent to old shared inboxes. Dana will replace those addresses and ask the supervisors to complete sign-in before the next roster review.
- Door 12 remains the useful test case for appointment changes: dispatch adjusts the arrival time, the yard desk checks the board, and the receiving supervisor checks the shift view.
- Thea wants the “Tomorrow by door” report sorted by appointment time. Dana will send a saved-view screenshot rather than another exported spreadsheet.

## Support follow-through

- Ticket ND-2841: a moved appointment stays visible in the old door filter until the dispatcher refreshes the board. Support has the screen recording from the afternoon shift.
- I will ask support for the reproduction result on 16 Sep 2025. Until then, the yard desk is refreshing after a door change and checking the appointment detail before calling a driver forward.
- Ticket ND-2846: invitation emails are being overlooked in a shared inbox. Dana will test the replacement addresses first; no bulk resend until those land.

## This week

- Marcus: close the Brackenwater Freight Co. trailer-field walkthrough and put the dispatch desk’s response in the handoff thread.
- Dana: finish the Quarrendon Freight Lines roster check with Thea and send the saved report view.
- Me: chase the board-refresh reproduction and remove the duplicate screenshots from the North folder. Keep the annotated version; it shows the filter state before and after the move.
